dct_description_sm: A limited amount of information is available on baculum and testicle anatomy of ringed seals and their mating system has been poorly documented as studies are constrained by logistical difficulties of acquiring behavioral information during the ice-covered spring breeding season. In this study, we described bacuum and testicle growth, variation, and allometry, and then applied a comparative approach among pinnipeds to provide insight into the mating system of ringed seals. Biological samples and information were gathered as part of the community-based monitoring network within the Canadian Arctic established by the Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada.
dct_title_s: Hudson Bay ringed seal baculum and testicle measurements
